# TurboFix

> TurboFix is an independent mobile phone service business in Hyderabad, India, offering doorstep service, pickup and delivery, and a walk-in studio in Nampally.

TurboFix technicians service phones at the customer's home or office anywhere in Hyderabad and Secunderabad, offer pickup and delivery, and run a walk-in studio at Bharat Nagar, Aghapura, Nampally, Hyderabad 500001. TurboFix is not affiliated with Apple, Samsung or any phone manufacturer.

Prices are quoted per phone after inspection, before any work; customers pay after the service. Parts carry a 3-, 6- or 12-month warranty depending on the part grade, confirmed with the quote. Model facts on the pages below are checked against manufacturer specifications, Apple Support documents and published teardowns, with sources listed on each page.

## Key Facts

- Name: TurboFix (website: turbofix.in)
- Founded: 2023 in Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- What it does: doorstep mobile phone service, pickup and delivery, and a walk-in studio
- Walk-in studio: Bharat Nagar, Aghapura, Nampally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001
- Areas served: Hyderabad and Secunderabad
- Hours: doorstep visits and studio 9 AM to 9 PM, every day; online and WhatsApp bookings 24/7
- Brands serviced: Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, OnePlus, Xiaomi/Redmi, Realme, Vivo, Oppo, Motorola, Google Pixel
- Services: screen replacement, battery replacement, charging port, camera, speaker and microphone, back glass, motherboard (chip-level) and water damage service
- Warranty: 3, 6 or 12 months on replaced parts, depending on part grade
- Payment: after the service; cash, UPI, cards and net banking
- Languages: English, Telugu, Hindi

## Services (all brands)

- [Screen replacement in Hyderabad](https://turbofix.in/screen-replacement-hyderabad): cracked or unresponsive display replacement at your doorstep or the Nampally studio, with part grades and warranty explained.
- [Battery replacement in Hyderabad](https://turbofix.in/battery-replacement-hyderabad): replacement of swollen, draining or degraded phone batteries, usually done during the doorstep visit.
- [Charging port service](https://turbofix.in/charging-port-service-hyderabad): diagnosis and cleaning or replacement of loose, slow or non-charging USB-C and Lightning ports.
- [Camera service](https://turbofix.in/camera-service-hyderabad): rear and front camera module and lens glass replacement for blurry, cracked or black camera faults.
- [Speaker and microphone service](https://turbofix.in/speaker-service-hyderabad): fixes for low or crackling earpiece and loudspeaker sound and microphones callers cannot hear.
- [Back panel replacement](https://turbofix.in/back-panel-replacement-hyderabad): cracked back glass and rear housing replacement for iPhone and Android phones.
- [Motherboard service](https://turbofix.in/motherboard-service-hyderabad): chip-level board diagnosis for dead phones, boot loops, no network and no power faults.
- [Water damage service](https://turbofix.in/water-damage-hyderabad): cleaning, drying and board-level treatment for phones exposed to water, with what to do in the first hour.
